body_html: By providing your email address or phone number, you expressly consent to receive communication and marketing materials from JAMMIN’ DJs / Infinity Entertainment and its affiliates. These communications may include, but are not limited to, promotional emails, newsletters, product updates, and special offers. You understand that you can opt out of receiving such communications at any time by using the unsubscribe link provided in our emails or by contacting our customer support. Your contact information will be kept confidential and will not be shared with third parties without your explicit consent.
